name: +1 Slap Power Per Step
desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Slap Power Per Step!

🏃 Every step you take boosts your speed and power
🧠 Train by running on treadmills or climbing the tower
😂 Slap other players off the map
🏆 Earn wins to unlock stronger multipliers
🌐 Dominate the server and become the strongest and fastest!

⭐ Like the game and join the group for more!
